presets.name: Transparent live
presets.desc: Steady pitch pulled 80 % onto the note; vibrato, bends and far-off notes left as sung; Live latency
presets.notes: The design's transparent setting (README §4): golem's default use; the song key is applied by golem when the scale is not Chromatic

presets.name: Live natural
presets.desc: Fast but not instant help on held notes (84 %, 33 ms): x42's own Live preset
presets.notes: x42-Autotune's factory Live preset (corr 0.84, filter 0.033), kept for golem users who knew it

presets.name: Slightly corrected
presets.desc: A third of the pitch error removed, slowly: the singer's own pitch, a little steadier

presets.name: Tight pop
presets.desc: Notes land fast on the key's scale, held notes stay human, vibrato kept
presets.notes: Two times: transition 15 ms for the landing, filter 40 ms on the held note (README §3.5 re-voicing of golem's Tight pop)

presets.name: Stair-step robot
presets.desc: Instant steps between the scale's notes, vibrato flattened: the 2000s hard-tune sound

refs.why: the instant note steps that made hard tuning an effect
the stair-step vocal used as the lead sound on every hook

presets.notes: filter 0 and transition 0 are the robot; the minor scale and a short note hold keep the steps on the melody's notes

presets.name: Hard tune, vibrato kept
presets.desc: Instant note steps while the singer's own vibrato rides on top of each note
presets.notes: The vibrato model splits the vibrato off once 2 – 3 of its cycles are heard; before that the first notes are flat

presets.name: Exaggerated vibrato
presets.desc: Locked notes with the singer's vibrato deepened to nearly twice its depth
presets.notes: Above 100 % the fitted sinusoid is added, so the jitter is not deepened with it

presets.name: Backing vocals lock
presets.desc: Unison and harmony lines pulled hard onto the notes so stacked voices lock together
presets.notes: Half the vibrato removed so stacked singers stop beating against each other

presets.name: Blues bends kept
presets.desc: Held notes helped toward the minor pentatonic; bends and blue notes beyond 60 cents left alone
presets.notes: Flex 100 %: 15 cents off is pulled fully, 60 cents or more is a deliberate bend and stays

presets.name: Sparse scale, steady
presets.desc: Pentatonic targets with a long note hold: an uncertain singer stays on the tune without hopping
presets.notes: Hysteresis 35 cents: the held note wins until the voice is 85 cents from it

presets.name: High voice, in-ears
presets.desc: Transparent correction for a high voice at the lowest latency (High register, 4.3 ms)
presets.notes: register High: 150 – 1,200 Hz, the Live latency falls to 4.3 ms; a setup parameter (changes the reported latency)

presets.name: Studio render
presets.desc: Every note corrected from its first cycle with the formants kept: for a recorded take
presets.notes: fastmode off = Studio (PSOLA, 26 ms in Mid): recalling it changes the reported latency, so keep it for renders, not live scenes

presets.name: Semitone down, formants kept
presets.desc: The whole voice a semitone lower with its vowels unchanged: a song moved down without retuning
presets.notes: Studio only keeps the formants in v1 (Live moves them 6 %); recalling it changes the reported latency

presets.name: Fretless and cello
presets.desc: Gentle intonation help for a fretless bass or a cello: low register, vibrato kept
presets.notes: register Low reaches 60 Hz; its Live latency is 9.3 ms

presets.name: Horns and strings
presets.desc: Light intonation help for trumpet, sax or violin; scoops and falls kept
presets.notes: Flex 60 %: scoops into the note are left, the held note is helped

presets.name: Pitch meter only
presets.desc: No correction: the block reads the sung note and its error for the singer's monitor
presets.notes: Read the note and error meters; the output is the input delayed by the Live latency
